description: This file implements the Controller class for the WPEFramework plugin system, handling initialization, deinitialization, request processing, subsystem management, and JSON-RPC invocation. It interacts with web requests, plugin services, and system information, and manages internal state and external dependencies.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: Main class managing plugin control, web request handling, subsystem management, and JSON-RPC invocation within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

methods.name: SubSystems
methods.description: Configures the subsystems based on the provided JSON array of subsystem enums.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the Controller with the given service, sets up configuration, probes, and web server.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters subsystems, and stops web services.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns static information about the controller; currently empty.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Processes incoming web requests, setting request bodies based on HTTP method and URL.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Handles web requests, routing to GET, PUT, POST, DELETE handlers based on HTTP verb.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a specified file or directory in the persistent path.

methods.name: Environment
methods.description: Retrieves environment variable value by key.

methods.name: Configuration
methods.description: Gets or sets configuration for a plugin identified by callsign.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Clones an existing plugin service to a new callsign.

methods.name: Hibernate
methods.description: Hibernates a plugin service for a specified timeout.

methods.name: GetMethod
methods.description: Handles GET requests for various metadata, environment variables, plugins, and system info.

methods.name: PutMethod
methods.description: Handles PUT requests for activating/deactivating plugins, updating configs, initiating discovery, persisting configs, or rebooting.

methods.name: DeleteMethod
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests, primarily for removing persistent files.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Handles state change events for plugins, including resuming plugins if configured.

methods.name: SubSystems
methods.description: Reports current subsystem statuses and notifies changes.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Handles JSON-RPC invocation, forwarding to specific services if needed.
